definitions.meaning: to repel, thrust or beat back, keep from, restrain, constrain, force

quotations.old_english: Hí fram his mágum ǽr mid unrihte anýdde wǽron
quotations.english: they had formerly been unjustly forced from his kinsmen

definitions.meaning: with út to expel, to drive

source_text: a-nýdan; p. -nýdde; pp. -nýded, pl. -nýdede = -nýdde [a from, nýdan to compel]. I. to repel, thrust or beat back, keep from, restrain, constrain, force; repellere, extorquere:--Hí fram his mágum ǽr mid unrihte anýdde wǽron they had formerly been unjustly forced from his kinsmen, Chr. 823; Th. 111, 34. II. with út to expel, to drive
